enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +20 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.

Utter Disintegration: This weapon has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies and attempts to disintegrate them. This disintegrate is incredibly powerful, and will utterly destroy weaker foes.
Legendary Paralysis: On hit, this has a chance of paralyzing your enemies. Struck enemies must make a DC 100 Fortitude save or be paralyzed.
Assassinate +15: +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.

Finesse +13: This weapon has a Small air elemental bound to it. The wielder can use a finesse weapon as if he had the Weapon Finesse feat. In addition, the weapon grants a +13 enhancement bonus to the wielder's Dexterity score.
